system.description: Common Specialist Base List (Elemental Companion) 5.6.2 - Elemental Defenses. Defensive spells built around the caster's own Main Element and Triad: personal and shared armor/shields/immunity, deflecting or containing incoming elemental bolts/cones/balls. Common to every Elemental Specialist (Fire, Ice, etc. based on profession); a GM may also allow Elemental Priests, Travelers, and Champions to develop it (Main Element chosen at character creation), but any other profession developing this list has no Main Element and cannot use the spells with the word 'Main' in their name. Levels 1 and 15 are intentionally blank in the source. Note: if Aether and Nether are used in the campaign, spells affecting Arcane elements are considered 10 levels higher for casting purposes (PPs and the spellcasting roll); the caster does not need to know the list to that higher level to use the effect.

Target is protected from all natural (Mundane) forms of caster's main element; additionally target gets +20 to Resistance Rolls (RR's) against the caster's Main Element; and elemental attacks from the caster's main element are at -20. These bonuses apply against Magical, High, and True forms of the caster's main element. This spell only works against attacks from the caster's Main Element (Fire, for a Fire Specialist; Ice, for an Ice Specialist, etc.)
One elemental "bolt" spell within range is deviated from its course. This causes 20 to be subtracted from the attack roll.
As Main Armor I except it works against any one element in the caster's triad. The element that this spell protects against must be chosen at the time of casting.
As Main Armor I except all beings within 10'R of the target are protected.
As Main Armor I, except it works against any one element. The element that this spell protects against must be chosen at the time of casting.

Caster uses elemental force to contain that of an elemental attack like a ball, cone or other area effect. This blunts the energy. It doesn't negate it. Target spell's attack rolls are modified by -20, if applicable. Alternately, any targets gain a +20 RR vs. the spell's effects, or any critical delivered is reduced by one degree of severity.

As Main Armor I, except it also decreases concussion hit damage from the caster's Main element by half, and decreases critical strikes by one level (e.g. 'A's become 'A'-25, 'B's become 'A's, 'C's become 'B's, etc.)
As Main Armor I, except it works against all three elements of the caster's triad.
As Triad Armor I, except all beings within 10' R of the target are protected.
As Turn Element, except the spell course deviation is more severe, causing 50 to be subtracted from the attack roll.
As Minor Containment except containing energy is more powerful causing 35 to be subtracted from the attack roll.
As Main Armor II except it affects any one element in the caster's triad, element affected is chosen at time of casting.
As Elemental Armor I, except all beings within 10' R of the target are protected.

Target is made completely immune to elemental attacks from the caster's Main Element. This applies to Mundane, Magical, and High Elemental Material. Target only receives a +50 DB/RR modifier against True Elemental Material.
As Deflect Element, except the spell's course deviation is more severe, causing 75 to be subtracted from the attack.
As Main Armor II, except it affects any one element. Element affected is chosen at time of casting.
As Prismatic Armor I, except it affects everyone within a 10'R of the target.
As Main Armor II, except it works against all three elements of the caster's triad.
As Main Immunity, except it works against any one element from the caster's triad. Element must be chosen at the time of casting.
As Minor Containment except the containing energy is more powerful causing 50 to be subtracted from the attack roll.
As Triad Immunity, except as many targets as the caster's level may be affected.
